subject: Ciências
description_pt: Discutir e avaliar mudanças econômicas, culturais e sociais, tanto na vida cotidiana quanto no mundo do trabalho, decorrentes do desenvolvimento de novos materiais e tecnologias (como automação e informatização).

components.description_pt: Identificar mudanças econômicas no cotidiano e no mundo do trabalho resultantes de novas tecnologias como automação e digitalização
components.description_en: Identify economic changes in everyday life and the world of work resulting from new technologies such as automation and digitization

components.description_pt: Identificar mudanças culturais e sociais resultantes do desenvolvimento de novos materiais e tecnologias
components.description_en: Identify cultural and social changes resulting from the development of new materials and technologies
components.cc_component_description: Assess potential social, cultural, and environmental impacts of a proposed engineering solution

components.description_pt: Avaliar os impactos da automação e digitalização na sociedade e no mercado de trabalho
components.description_en: Evaluate the impacts of automation and digitization on society and the labor market
components.cc_component_description: Assess potential social, cultural, and environmental impacts of a proposed engineering solution

components.description_pt: Discutir conflitos associados à adoção de novos materiais e tecnologias na vida contemporânea
components.description_en: Discuss trade-offs associated with the adoption of new materials and technologies in contemporary life
components.cc_component_description: Analyze trade-offs, constraints, and ethical issues when comparing alternative design solutions

cc_matches.description: Evaluate a solution to a complex real-world problem based on prioritized criteria and trade-offs that account for a range of constraints, including cost, safety, reliability, and aesthetics as well as possible social, cultural, and environmental impacts.
Compare and evaluate competing arguments or design solutions in light of currently accepted explanations, new evidence, limitations (e.g., trade-offs), constraints, and ethical issues.
